title: ÆTHER: Overtake v3 (high-energy positive race chase, F1-style)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: A high-energy, positive, uplifting race film score: the final laps of a motor racing championship, a young driver charging from last place to win in front of a roaring crowd. Bright, triumphant, sunny and euphoric, full of speed and joy, not dark, not dangerous, not villainous. Major key, fast and driving at 150 BPM from the very first second. Sound: pulsing sixteenth-note synth arpeggios, a driving palm-muted electric guitar riff that opens up into big power chords, huge punchy modern drums with fast tom fills, a bouncing melodic bass, soaring orchestral strings and bold heroic brass, bright and glossy, wide and modern. ONE big, catchy stadium-anthem hook everyone could sing, in E major pentatonic E F# G# B C#, phrased like a singer with quick slides into the high notes, coming back bigger every time; a crowd of voices answers it with a wordless 'whoa-oh-oh' chant. Timeline: 0-2 s: a bright full-band hit and the synth arpeggio racing at full speed instantly. 2-12 s: the guitar riff and drums drive hard, the hook on a shining synth lead. 12-22 s: the hook moves to soaring strings and brass together, the crowd chant answers. 22-32 s: the hook moves to a singing electric guitar lead with slides over pounding drums and claps. 32-44 s: everything lifts a whole step higher into F#, the drums double up, the hook on brass, strings and crowd chant together, pure euphoria. 44-54 s: a fast triplet drum run and rising strings, the hook traded between guitar and synth, the final lap. 54-60 s: the winning moment: three huge full-band hits, a big triumphant final chord ringing out with the crowd cheering. Positive and inspiring all the way, no minor-key darkness, no slow or quiet parts, no engine sounds, no white-noise risers, no EDM drop, no side-chain pumping, no lyrics, no words.

brief.notes: Jithesh 1 Nov 07:48: 'I need a high energy positive kind of car chase, which fits into an F1 movie or something.' v1 'nothing interesting'; v2 (dark siren chase) no verdict. v3 flips the mood: bright, triumphant, major key, sunlight and glory, not danger. Palette: pulsing synth arpeggios, driving palm-muted electric guitar, big punchy drums, soaring strings and brass, a stadium-anthem hook with a gang 'whoa-oh' chant. Indian touch as melody style only (Mohanam in E, a bright pentatonic that sounds natural to world ears, with slides on the lead). Loud and fast from 0 s, a new lead every ~10 s via the timeline, no engine sounds, no silence stops (the model ignores them). 150 BPM, 60 s, 2 takes.

story: Race day. A young driver starts last on the grid and charges through the whole field, lap after lap, to take the chequered flag in front of a roaring crowd.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
